variants.title: Classic
variants.description: Classic chess with opponents from beginner to full strength, game history, and PGN analysis.

variants.title: Alternating colors
variants.description: Stockfish but its moves alternate between light and dark squares.

variants.title: SCP-096
variants.description: Stockfish but SCP-096 stalks the board and eats pieces it sees.

variants.title: Sufferfish
variants.description: Plays near-perfect chess but avoids captures: picks the best quiet move unless a capture is clearly better.

variants.title: Courier
variants.description: Each side gets a random, untouchable pawn that steps like a king. Win by checkmate or by walking your Courier off the far edge.
